issues.description: Mismatch in the columns that Aufgabe 01 asks for vs. what the template and solution provide. The problem statement (Aufgabe 01) requires the zoo name and its internet address (columns: Zoo.name, Zoo.url) and the municipality name and its Regierungsbezirk (Gemeinde.name, Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk). The template (template_repository/aufgabe01.sql lines 1-2) only selects Zoo.name and Gemeinde.name and does not include a join condition, so it omits the required Zoo.url and Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk and gives no hint about the join. The solution (solution_repository/aufgabe01.sql lines 1-3) uses SELECT Zoo.*, Gemeinde.* and therefore returns all columns from both tables (including extra, unspecified columns) rather than exactly the four columns requested. This inconsistency can confuse students about which columns they must output and may make automated equality checks fail because the reference returns more columns than the exercise specifies.
issues.suggestedFix:
Make the expected columns consistent across artifacts. Update the solution to select only the requested columns and use an explicit join, e.g.:
SELECT Zoo.name, Zoo.url, Gemeinde.name, Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk
FROM Zoo
JOIN Gemeinde ON Zoo.gemeindeschluessel = Gemeinde.schluessel;
And update the template to either include the correct join and the column names as a hint or add a short TODO comment making explicit that students must include Zoo.url and Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk and the join condition. This preserves the learning goal while removing ambiguity for students and automated checks.
